name: 3D FEA (parametric parts)
description: Linear elastic 3D FEA of a single parametric OpenPara part: pick faces for supports (fixed, one direction, bolt hole) and loads (force, pressure, force at a vertex, gravity), quadratic tetrahedra from gmsh, von Mises, displacement and safety factor, animation. A .gpv project folder with its own copy of the part; works with Parametric Studies.
